name: LICIEL
positioning: The software French property diagnosticians produce their regulated reports in.
description: LICIEL publishes software for the French diagnostic immobilier profession: DPE energy performance, asbestos, lead, gas, electricity, termites, surface measurement and the assembled dossier de diagnostic technique, with report generation, on-site capture and transmission to the required registries.
real_estate_use: No French property can be sold or let without its diagnostic file, and the DPE in particular now carries legal consequences — a G-rated dwelling cannot be let. The diagnostician's software has to produce a report conforming to the current method and transmit it to the ADEME registry; when the method changes, the software is what has to change with it.
features: Report production for every regulated French diagnostic
DPE calculation following the current regulatory method
On-site capture on tablet with photos and measurements
Assembly of the dossier de diagnostic technique

use_cases.job: Produce a regulation-compliant DPE and transmit it to the official registry
Obtain a complete diagnostic file before a mandate goes on the market
